_comment: Source of truth for site photos. Run: python scripts/optimize_photos.py <folder of originals named <id>.jpg>. Originals came from the school Drive (VPPS School Marketing, 13_AI_Visual_Library real-photo folders) and Google Photos (Sports Day 2026, Inter House Dance 2025, Veer Patta Cultural 2026). No photos from RESTRICTED or AI-generated folders.
